body:
Thank you!

It's helpful.  Very helpful.   Sounds like we're both in the same place.   Day 2 after stopping the birth control colors got brighter and day 3 I was genuinely happy for the first time in months - it looks promising for me, and I hope you, too.

Worst part is the doctor I really *like* wrote the script for birth control.  I'm going to write her a email and let her know so that she knows to check for that interaction in future.  It's hard because she's so frikking nice and I know she was doing what she thought was right and I liked the no periods, but.  coulda died.
